subject: radiology
title: Venous access and IVC filters

steps.tx: Venous access choice follows therapy length and vein quality, because each device trades convenience against infection and thrombosis. A **peripheral cannula** suits days, while a **PICC line** suits weeks to months of antibiotics or fluids. A tunnelled catheter suits dialysis and prolonged therapy, and an **implantable port** suits intermittent chemotherapy over months. The **right internal jugular vein** gives the straightest run toward the cava under ultrasound guidance for placement. Tip position at the cavoatrial junction needs confirmation before vesicant drugs run through the line safely.
steps.say: Venous access choice follows therapy length and vein quality because each device trades convenience against harm. A peripheral cannula is suitable for days while an arm line suits weeks to months of treatment. A tunnelled catheter suits dialysis and prolonged therapy and a port suits intermittent chemotherapy. The right neck vein gives the straightest run toward the cava under ultrasound guidance. Tip position needs confirmation before vesicant drugs run through the line safely afterwards.

steps.tx: Malignant caval obstruction presents dramatically, and stenting relieves that presentation faster than drugs alone usually can. **Superior vena cava syndrome** causes facial swelling, plethora and dilated chest collaterals that worsen over days. **Venous stenting** suits a patient who needs urgent relief before or alongside cancer treatment in hospital. A chemosensitive tumour may resolve with drugs alone, while a tight stricture needs **balloon predilation** before stent deployment. Bilateral brachiocephalic disease needs kissing stents, and anticoagulation after stenting follows local protocol in practice.

steps.tx: This coronal CT venogram shows both **brachiocephalic veins** joining above a tight **SVC stricture** in the mediastinum. Dilated **collateral vessels** snake down the chest wall because caval blood finds longer routes around the blockage. Labels above and below the stricture mark the **stent landing zones** that the operator needs for complete coverage. The image matters for the exam because landing zone choice decides whether a caval stent stays open. Urgent stenting then relieves facial swelling while cancer treatment addresses the underlying cause.

Dilated collateral vessels snake down the chest wall because caval blood finds longer routes. Labels above and below the narrowing mark the landing zones that the operator needs. steps.tx: An IVC filter traps travelling clot when anticoagulation cannot protect the lungs during a dangerous period. Core indications are **venous thromboembolism with contraindication** to anticoagulation and **recurrent embolism despite adequate therapy** in hospital. A **retrievable filter** suits temporary risk such as trauma or perioperative bleeding with recovery expected soon. A **permanent filter** suits a lifelong contraindication where retrieval would never become safe for that patient. The device sits below the renal veins so renal drainage stays open after deployment in the cava.
steps.say: A caval filter traps travelling clot when anticoagulation cannot protect the lungs during danger. Core indications are clot with a contraindication to anticoagulation and recurrence despite adequate therapy. A retrievable filter suits temporary risk such as trauma or perioperative bleeding with recovery expected. A permanent filter suits a lifelong contraindication where retrieval would never become safe later. The device is placed below the renal veins so renal drainage stays open after deployment.

steps.tx: A filter that stays behind becomes a hazard, so retrieval planning starts on the day of insertion. **Retrieval** takes booking as soon as protection ends and thinners resume, ideally within weeks to a few months. A **tilted filter** with an embedded hook needs advanced retrieval with loops or forceps in expert hands. Neglected devices cause caval thrombosis, strut fracture with embolisation, migration and difficult removal over time. A **filter registry** with recall dates prevents the commonest failure, which remains simple forgetting of the device.
